name: Aurelius Technologies Berhad
summary: Aurelius Technologies Berhad functions as an investment holding company, delivering comprehensive electronic manufacturing services (EMS) to a variety of industries. Its core capabilities encompass the production of printed circuit board assemblies (PCBA), diverse sub-assemblies, and complete box-build systems. The company further specializes in advanced test development and execution, prototype creation and New Product Introduction (NPI) support, subsequent processing steps, and the application of lean manufacturing principles. Beyond production, Aurelius Technologies provides expertise in new product integration, sophisticated surface mount technology (SMT), tailored test system development, engineering solutions, and robust supply chain and quality management. It serves sectors such as communication and IoT, multicomponent semiconductor modules, energy, power electronics, and lighting. Established in 1993, the company's headquarters are located in Kulim, Malaysia.
